items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... I’m very pleased to have veteran trombonist Eddie Bert with me. [INTERVIEWEE] Thanks for having me.

ctx.x: Eddie has played on numerous recordings, including historical LPs by Charles Mingus, Thad Jones and Thelonious Monk. He continues to compose and perform as he enters his sixth decade as a professional musician.
Eddie was interviewed in Danbury, Connecticut on November 20, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Danbury, Connecticut. I’m very pleased to have veteran trombonist Eddie Bert with me. Thank you very much for joining me.
